profiles.name: Hengeyokai
speciesTraits: A playable shapechanger with three forms: human, animal, and bipedal hybrid. Choose one animal kind. A character keeps that animal kind and its corresponding hybrid throughout play.

Original D&D 3.0: Wisdom −2, Shapechanger type, and level adjustment +1. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply, but shapechanger effects do. The published setting places Hengeyokai outside Rokugan.
Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full round and provokes attacks of opportunity. The original printing references the D&D 3.0 polymorph rules.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.

profiles.name: Hengeyokai
speciesTraits: A playable shapechanger with three forms: human, animal, and bipedal hybrid. Choose one animal kind. A character keeps that animal kind and its corresponding hybrid throughout play.

Original D&D 3.0: Wisdom −2, Shapechanger type, and level adjustment +1. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply, but shapechanger effects do. The published setting places Hengeyokai outside Rokugan.
Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full round and provokes attacks of opportunity. The original printing references the D&D 3.0 polymorph rules.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.
Sparrow hybrid. Dexterity +2. Walk 20 ft. and fly 20 ft. (average).
Sparrow animal form. Fine, walk 1 ft., fly 50 ft., AC 24. Str 1, Dex 23, Con 10. Natural attack damage: no natural damage listed.

The 2002 errata supplies average maneuverability for hybrid flight. The 2003 FAQ describes hands at the wing ends. In flight, carry only light weapons or objects of up to 6 lb, and no shield or buckler.
